explanations.trigger_explanation: Structures or work in, over, under, or affecting navigable waters of the United States commonly trigger a Section 10 Department of the Army permit for utility crossings and similar linear work.

known_unknowns: Whether a specific waterbody is a navigable water of the United States should be confirmed with the district office.
advisories: Additional review recommended where the crossing is in or affects a traditionally navigable river, channel, or other Section 10 water.
notes: Confidence tier 1 because the permit requirement is directly stated in federal regulation; project-specific navigability determinations still need confirmation.
